evidence: The paper builds random forest models for virtual screening and states: "Stepwise feature selection was performed during model optimization in Pipeline Pilot using the 'caret' package in R...Model improvement was defined as an increase in 5-fold cross-validated R²." No variable importance scores, rankings, or interpretations are reported. Conclusions rely entirely on predictive performance metrics and experimental validation: "From this screen, 32 compounds were ordered and 5 out of 32 compounds (16% hit rate) showed a similar affinity as the reference high-affinity NET inhibitor nisoxetine," with corroboration through TRACT assay experimental validation rather than impurity importance analysis.
